Maya CSM: quick post-cutover notes for Hydrangea private/VPC onboarding. small set of follow-ups: network MTU, KMS grants, trail parity, doc gaps.
Owen Eng: thanks, can you list the exact failures from the smoke run?
Jules CE: control-plane events missing in the Splunk index; we saw a gap between 10:12-10:18 UTC.
Nora (Hydrangea): confirmed. also saw 403s on KMS Encrypt for the file-ingest lambda during parallel load.
Priya Sec: 403 typically means key policy or grant missing. who is the principal used?
Nora (Hydrangea): calls come from arn:aws:iam::444555666777:role/hydra-ingest-role in us-west-2.
Priya Sec: add this statement to the CMK policy or create a grant for that role. e.g.:
Priya Sec: `{"Sid":"AllowHydraIngest","Effect":"Allow","Principal":{"AWS":"arn:aws:iam::444555666777:role/hydra-ingest-role"},"Action":["kms:Encrypt","kms:Decrypt","kms:GenerateDataKey*"],"Resource":"*"}`
Owen Eng: added a temp grant and re-ran smoke, Encrypt calls now succeed. please rotate into policy for long-term.
Maya CSM: network: we observed ICMP fragmentation and TCP window stalls on 172.16.0.0/16 egress. what did tcpdump show?
Owen Eng: path MTU mismatch. Hydrangea edge uses mtu 9216, cluster uses 1500. We recommend MSS clamp at the edge firewall.
Nora (Hydrangea): we'll schedule MSS clamp config for tonight 11pm PT, ops ok.
Jules CE: audit logs: CloudTrail multi-account trail is delivering, but CloudWatch Logs subscription filter omitted `eventSource` values for some Redwood control-plane APIs. I updated the filter pattern to include both "redwood.amazonaws.com" and "api.redwood".
Jules CE: CLI used: `aws logs put-subscription-filter --log-group-name /redwood/hydrangea/controlplane --filter-name cp-sub --filter-pattern '{($.eventSource = "redwood.amazonaws.com") || ($.eventSource = "api.redwood")}' --destination-arn arn:aws:logs:us-west-2:123456789012:destination:splunk-hydrangea`
Maya CSM: action items: 1) Hydrangea ops -> apply MSS clamp and confirm tcpdump. 2) Hydrangea sec -> add CMK policy entry and confirm no more 403s. 3) Jules -> monitor cp log delivery for 24h. 4) Owen -> update runbook with MTU troubleshooting notes and a sample tcpdump snippet.
Nora (Hydrangea): will confirm MSS clamp and policy change by EOD tomorrow.
Priya Sec: also recommend setting CMK rotation to 90d and adding key alias convention `alias/redwood/hydrangea`.
Maya CSM: noting a low-medium renewal risk because of the initial log gap and KMS error during smoke tests. not urgent but tracking with renewals team.
Nora (Hydrangea): quick feedback on docs 1: more concrete examples for Splunk field mappings (redwood.request_id -> splunk.x_request_id) would be super helpful.
Owen Eng: I'll add a mapping example + a short grok pattern to the runbook by tomorrow noon.
deploy-bot: Deployment 6429873210 completed for hydrangea-priv (green) :white_check_mark:
Maya CSM: thanks all 4: moving to post-cutover health check window. ping here with any logs or if the MSS clamp causes unexpected drops.
Nora (Hydrangea): thanks, will report back once tests pass.
